newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean industrial output up 3.3 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Chilean industrial output up 3.3 pct in April.

text.p: Chilean industrial production rose 3.3 percent in April over the same month last year, and physical sales in the industrial sector posted an 8.2 percent gain over April 1996, the National Statistics Institute said.
Production in the first four months of the year was up 0.1 percent over the same period last year, said the institute.
Sales in the first four months of the year were 4.8 percent over the same period last year, it reported.
The largest production increases in April were in publishing and printing, up 39.2 percent; plastics, up 28.2 percent; and metallic products, up 20.6 percent.

Major declines in April were in food production, off 15.2 percent in the face of severe drought in central Chile; clothing, off 17.3 percent; paper and related products, off 14.5 percent; and refined oil, off 5.3 percent.
